Lodge Overview
Wake up to lion calls and golden plains. Serengeti Safari Lodge sits in the heart of Central Serengeti, offering front-row views of Africa's greatest wildlife show. Comfortable tents, warm hospitality, and endless game drives await. Book your stay at Serengeti Safari Lodge today and step into the wild.
Serengeti Safari Lodge is located in the Seronera area of Central Serengeti, right in the middle of Serengeti National Park . This is one of the best wildlife spots in Tanzania, with animals to see all year round. The lodge has 15 spacious, self-contained tents , each with its own private shower and toilet . Guests can relax in comfort after a day of adventure. The lodge blends into its natural surroundings, so you feel close to nature while still enjoying modern comfort.
At Serengeti Safari Lodge, guests can enjoy morning and afternoon game drives to see lions, elephants, giraffes , and more. The lodge sits near the route of the Great Migration , when millions of wildebeest and zebra move across the plains in search of fresh grass, making it a great base for watching this famous journey. The lodge also has a restaurant serving local and international food , a cozy lounge , and friendly staff who are always ready to help plan your day.
Around Serengeti Safari Lodge, the land is mostly open grassland, but the nearby Seronera River has patches of green riverine forest. This forest is full of life. Leopards often rest on tree branches here, hiding from the afternoon sun. Guests may also spot vervet monkeys , olive baboons, and many colorful birds moving through the trees. The mix of open plains and shady riverine forest makes this one of the richest wildlife areas in the whole Serengeti.

About Us - Tanzania Wild Camp
Skip to content
About Us
Our story
Founded by Zainab Ansell , Tanzania Wild Camps is proudly Tanzanian-owned and built on more than 40 years of experience in the tourism and hospitality industry. Her journey reflects a deep commitment to showcasing the beauty of Tanzania while ensuring that tourism creates meaningful opportunities for the people and places that make every experience possible.
With a strong focus on community impact, conservation, and responsible tourism, Zainab has championed an approach that goes beyond providing memorable safari experiences. Her leadership has also helped create opportunities for local communities and demonstrated the important role of women in leadership within Tanzania’s tourism industry.
Today, Tanzania Wild Camps continues to carry forward this vision — combining authentic hospitality with a responsibility to protect Tanzania’s natural heritage, support its communities, and contribute to a more sustainable future for tourism.
ZAINAB ANSELL, CEO TANZANIA WILD CAMPS
Our Collection of Safari Camps
Welcome to Tanzania Wild Camps, where we offer the most authentic safari camps and lodges in Tanzania.
Each of our accommodation options is tastefully designed to give you utmost comfort for an unforgettable and authentic Safari experience complemented by our professional and friendly hospitality team.
Award-Winning Tented Camps
Tanzania Wild Camps has been awarded as the Best Experience Safari Tented Stay in Tanzania 2021 by the International Travel Awards.
The International Travel Awards is crafted to honor the excellent performers in the tourism and travel industry around the world.
We are very humbled to receive this award and we thank everyone for the continued support.
This is how we enjoy our evenings under the start at the Serengeti Safari Lodge enjoying local BBQ with amazing Maasai stories.
Located at Central Serengeti and This time we have family rooms designed to accommodate your family groups and all other rooms types are available.

Hotel Overview
Rest above the clouds at Highview Hotel, perched on a hilltop in Karatu with sweeping valley views. Enjoy cozy rooms, a warm pool, and fresh coffee from our own plantation. The perfect stop between Ngorongoro Crater and Lake Manyara. Book Highview Hotel and start your Tanzania safari in comfort.
Highview Hotel sits high on a hill above Karatu town, with wide views over a green valley and rolling hills. The hotel opened in 2006 and has grown into one of the most loved stops on the Northern Safari Circuit. It has 41 comfortable rooms , each with an en-suite bathroom , and is set within its own coffee plantation. Guests can walk through the coffee bushes, breathe fresh mountain air, and enjoy the calm, quiet setting.
Highview Hotel offers many facilities for a relaxing stay. There is a large restaurant serving local and international dishes, a lounge with a bar and fireplace , a modern swimming pool , and a spa for massages . The hotel also hosts cultural shows with local music, dance, and acrobatics , giving guests a taste of Tanzanian culture. Highview Hotel is a perfect base for trips to Ngorongoro Crater, Lake Manyara, and Lake Eyasi. Guests can also join day trips to a nearby coffee farm or the Iraqw cultural center .
The hotel is surrounded by the green highlands of Karatu, close to the forested slopes on the southern side of the Ngorongoro Conservation Area . Guests who enjoy walking can hike into this cool, misty highland forest, home to blue monkeys, colorful turacos , and many other forest birds . Wild elephants sometimes wander down from these forests at night to visit the coffee farms nearby, so guests staying at Highview Hotel are truly close to nature, even without leaving the hotel grounds.
